integrity: Staticity is checked directly from the defining Hom--tensor evaluation map over F_2, rather than inherited from a disputed source proposition. A standalone exhaustive script verifies all three embeddings of the one-dimensional coordinate-line code into F_2^2 and all length-two binary monomial restrictions.
scientific_limitations: The result refutes Corollary 3.1.5 as stated for ordinary injective module embeddings. It does not refute a repaired version that assumes Hamming isometry, and it does not decide whether the later Morita-invariance conclusion has another valid proof. The publisher date is the earliest verified public date found; an unindexed earlier dissemination remains possible.
title: A length-two binary counterexample to the static-code extension corollary
